archive_metadata_already_observed.latlon_global_attribute: sonar position: lat/lon signed decimal degrees
archive_metadata_already_observed.ship_latlon_global_attribute: ship position: lat/lon signed decimal degrees

question: Does archived PRISM CDF latlon provide a defensible per-ping sonar/vehicle-navigation product distinct from ship_latlon, and where does it place the already frozen Earth-cell at the target ping?
forbidden_reads: any feature ranking used to choose ping or coordinate

semantic_tests.S1_DIRECT_METADATA: The CDF must self-describe latlon as sonar position and ship_latlon as ship position.
semantic_tests.S2_SHIP_CONTROL: At matched times, ship_latlon must track independent cd169.nav materially better than latlon does. Frozen dominance rule: median(ship_latlon-to-cd169.nav) < median(latlon-to-cd169.nav).
semantic_tests.S3_SEPARATION: latlon and ship_latlon must not be numerically identical over the target/anchor interval; report per-row separation without fitting.
semantic_tests.S4_HISTORICAL_TOBI_CHECK: At science-log TOBI anchors, report latlon-to-log and ship_latlon-to-log residuals. The log is a historical consistency check, not independent absolute ground truth.
semantic_tests.S5_NO_FIT: No offsets, yaw corrections, current terms, temporal shifts or coordinate translations may be fitted.

target_rule.row_selection: nearest archived CDF timestamp to frozen UTC, chosen by time only
target_rule.mapping: Use archived CDF sonar position plus CDF header heading/fish_altitude if valid; otherwise use already frozen raw-header heading/altitude. Convert Earth-cell offset to cross-track/slant range and 0.75 m raw sample axis without intensity inspection.
target_rule.material_sample_shift_rule: Report exact geometry-selected raw sample. Do not define a new threshold after seeing it. Compare descriptively with prior 819 and V2 821; any later feature read must use only this geometry-selected sample.

G3B_PASS_IF: target has finite per-ping latlon and timestamp
